answer: Make association carry risk both ways. Attesting an identity inherits a share of its liability, so vouching for a suspected farm raises your own verification costs — and the farm’s wallets inherit your scrutiny too. Honest agents keep their distance; sybil clusters become radioactive, because touching them is expensive. The cluster sits alone on its mesa, echoing its own signal, while the real economy trades across separate knolls. Isolation compounds: toxicity spreads faster than any farm can mint.
